notes: وَ بِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ opens the report: the names before the first name it writes (أحمد) are taken from prev1, which writes its chain; the report's own levels follow

Uncertain how far the inheritance runs: prev1 continues past Ali b. Husayn to Ahmad's father and Abu Basir, which this report does not repeat; if the whole prev1 chain were meant the reading would differ, for review
ع after the Imam is a blessing, not part of the surface
